creator.description:
a label service to show off who's your (vtuber) oshi is/are, think of it like discord's "role" or to hide people whose oshi is vtubers you don't like. 
contact the owner @primula.moe or @primula.my.id to request your own oshi labels!

locales.description: Shizuka Rin (静凛) is a female Japanese Virtual YouTuber and a member of NIJISANJI first generation of Livers along with Tsukino Mito, Higuchi Kaede, Elu, Yuki Chihiro, Shibuya Hajime, Suzuya Aki, and Moira. Within the first generation, she also forms the unit "JK-gumi" (JK組, high school girl group) with Tsukino Mito and Higuchi Kaede.
locales.name: Shizuka Rin💜🥦🐺

locales.description: Tsukino Mito (月ノ美兎) is a female Japanese Virtual YouTuber and a member of NIJISANJI first generation of Livers along with Yuki Chihiro, Elu, Higuchi Kaede, Shizuka Rin, Shibuya Hajime, Suzuya Aki, and Moira. A well-dressed and well-spoken 16-year-old high school "iinchou" (委員長, class president). Within the first generation, Mito forms the unit "JK-gumi" (JK組, high school girl gang) with Shizuka Rin and Higuchi Kaede.
locales.name: Tsukino Mito🐰
